results.title: Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF: Implicit Assumption, Failure Modes, and Provable Alignment
results.snippet: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a popular alternative to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), offering theoretical equivalence with simpler implementation. We prove this equivalence is conditional rather than universal, depending on an implicit assumption frequently violated in practice: the RLHF-optimal policy must prefer human-preferred responses. When this assumption fails, DPO optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy rather than absolute alignment with human preferences, leading to pathological convergence where policies decrease DPO loss wh…

results.title: Improving LLM Safety and Helpfulness using SFT and DPO: A Study on OPT-350M
results.snippet: This research investigates the effectiveness of alignment techniques, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and a combined SFT+DPO approach on improving the safety and helpfulness of the OPT-350M language model. Utilizing the Anthropic Helpful-Harmless RLHF dataset, we train and evaluate four models: the base OPT350M, an SFT model, a DPO model, and a model trained with both SFT and DPO. We introduce three key evaluation metrics: Harmlessness Rate (HmR), Helpfulness Rate (HpR), and a Combined Alignment Score (CAS), all derived from reward model outputs. The result…

findings.point: DPO 与 RLHF 的理论等价性是有条件的，而非普适的，取决于一个隐含假设：RLHF 最优策略必须偏好人类偏好的回复。当该假设失效时，DPO 优化的是相对于参考策略的相对优势，而非与人类偏好的绝对对齐，导致病态收敛。
findings.evidence: 论文证明了 DPO 与 RLHF 的等价性依赖于隐含假设，指出假设失效时 DPO 会优化相对优势而非绝对对齐，存在不可取的解空间。
findings.attention: 中：2026 年最新理论工作，揭示 DPO 核心假设失效条件，对对齐算法选择有指导意义
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆：理论贡献扎实，直接关系到 RLHF/DPO 选型与工程落地，建议对齐研究者精读

findings.point: 在 OPT-350M 上的实证研究显示：SFT 单独使用优于 DPO 单独使用；SFT+DPO 组合在无害率、有用率和综合对齐分数上均优于单独使用任一方法，表明两者互补。
findings.evidence: 使用 Anthropic Helpful-Harmless RLHF 数据集，对比 base、SFT、DPO、SFT+DPO 四种模型，引入 HmR、HpR、CAS 三个指标，结果显示组合方法最优。
findings.attention: 中：小模型实证研究，提供 SFT 与 DPO 组合的实验证据，工程参考价值较高
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：实证结论对小模型对齐管线有参考，但规模仅 350M，大模型泛化性待验证

results.snippet: Reward models learned from human preferences are central to aligning large language models (LLMs) via reinforcement learning from human feedback, yet they are often vulnerable to reward hacking due to noisy annotations and systematic biases such as response length or style. We propose Bayesian Non-Negative Reward Model (BNRM), a principled reward modeling framework that integrates non-negative factor analysis into Bradley-Terry (BT) preference model. BNRM represents rewards through a sparse, non-negative latent factor generative process that operates at two complementary levels: instance-spec…

results.title: RMB: Reward Model Boosting Mitigates Reward Hacking
results.snippet: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is a powerful technique for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preference. However, it often suffers from the reward hacking issue, where policy optimization improves the proxy reward model while actually degrading performance with respect to the true human preference, due to the imperfection of the proxy. To address this, we propose Reward Model Boosting (RMB), a novel approach that enhances the robustness and reliability of the reward signal for RLHF. | **可扩展监督评测碎片化** | 首个专用基准 [18] 2025-04 才出现，协议覆盖度、指标标准化仍在早期 | 基准驱动方法迭代的正向循环尚未形成（对比 LLM 通用基准） | [18][21] | 中 |

| **校准与不确定性量化未纳入标准对齐管线** | [25] 尝试贝叶斯建模，但无标准库/指标/基准 | 监管/合规要求（EU AI Act, SB 1047 等）可能强制引入不确定性报告 | [19][25] | 中 |
